QuestInfo.name: What Sen wants to eat
QuestInfo.1: Nina is wondering what to make her brother, Sen, for dinner. Go talk to Sen, who's next to Nina, and ask him what he wants to eat.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Sen, Nina's brother, what he wants for dinner. He said he wants #bMushroom Soup#k.

0.1: That's my little brother, #r#p2001##k. Will you please ask him what he wants for dinner?
0.0: Oh, a traveler! Nice, right on time... I have a favor to ask. Head towards your right and you'll find a boy.

no.0: Oh, I guess you're very busy. Still, it's not too difficult of a job, so please help if you can.

npc.0: You didn't talk to #p2001# yet? Please, open your eyes!
